title: What's the finish time for the driver who ranked second in 2008's AustChine
question:
What's the finish time for the driver who ranked second in 2008's AustChineseralian Grand Prix?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: finish time refers to time; Chinese Grand Prix refers to races.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix';

prediction.sql:
SELECT r.XCL_084
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
JOIN seasons s ON ra.XCL_066 = s.XCL_091
WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND s.XCL_091 = 2008
  AND r.XCL_077 = 2
